# Path_State_Awareness

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-16

## Definition
Continuous monitoring and modeling of per-path quality metrics (latency, loss, jitter) to inform routing decisions. Provides the real-time feedback loop needed for adaptive multipath selection in dynamic network topologies.
